name: sdpmlab/php-spiffe
description: PHP implementation of the SPIFFE Workload API — X.509/JWT SVID management, mTLS context adapters, and cross-process credential sharing via Swoole.

suggest.ext-swoole: Required for SwooleSpiffeWorkloadAPIClient, X509Source/JwtSource coroutine watchers, and Swoole Table shared memory (>=5.0).
suggest.ext-swow: Alternative coroutine runtime — use with Workerman for non-Swoole deployments (>=1.2).
suggest.ext-protobuf: C extension for 10–50x faster protobuf serialization (replaces pure-PHP google/protobuf runtime).
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required for SpiffeTlsContext::forGuzzle() and createGuzzleClient() adapters (^7.0).
suggest.workerman/workerman: Required for WorkermanSpiffeAuth middleware and forWorkerman() TLS adapter (^4.1 || ^5.0).
suggest.spiral/roadrunner-worker: Alternative worker runtime — use RoadRunner's TLS termination with PEM file output from SpiffeWorkloadWatcher (^3.0).
